references.source: W.D. Pilkey & D.F. Pilkey, Peterson's Stress Concentration Factors, 3rd ed., Wiley (2008), Chart 4.1 (finite-width tension strip with a central circular hole; Howland 1930, Phil. Trans. R. Soc. A 229:49-86): K_tn = 2 + 0.284(1-d/W) - 0.600(1-d/W)^2 + 1.32(1-d/W)^3, sigma_max = K_tn sigma0 W/(W-d)
references.notes: K_tn(0.3) = 2.3576. Curve fit to Howland's series solution for an infinite strip; Peterson gives no error bound for the fit, 2 % covers fit + digitisation. The model's ends are 2 W from the hole (end effects ~1e-3).
